answer: Key the bond to a hardware root of trust, so one machine holds one bond, and reset the record the moment two identities share funding, host, or inviter. A lazy operator reuses the same box for 200 aliases; the first link check resets all 200 to zero and the bonds stay locked. Cost is 1 machine per identity, no exceptions, plus the reset risk on every clone. The zephyr of a fast fleet dies on the reef, and the zenith of the payout table is 1 bond away per seat.
